scope: Same V13 frozen model, revealed R and first-ride/720s oracle tail.
contract: All original integer-clock platform actions and actual public observations retained. No original A/B prefixes, visible observations or public action choices removed.
center: For an eligible A/B board, replace the clipped arrival cost with its exact conditional mean given the sampled latent departure anchor. Keep sampled oracle continuation; clip total loss at the cap. Enable only when no later same-trip event is observable at the waiting stop before boarding.
stratified: Each original departure-prefix atom has two private next-arrival strata of exact probability under its chain conditional law. Keep original future in its own stratum and draw a true-law residual conditional suffix in the other. Compare fixed-policy costs before minimizing. Residual futures are sampled, not integrated exactly.
conditional_difference: Enumerate all independently selected one-future-per-prefix subbanks and average their minima with exact stratum weights. Jensen makes the difference pointwise nonnegative; its expectation is at most D. Substitute zero for an unfinished conditional comparison.
inference: Eight independent outer banks per root. Bonferroni .05 over three roots and six one-sided endpoints per root. An upper bound on V_Rtau is not implied by empirical stratification. The penalty is valid but need not improve Z. Stratification improvement holds in expectation.
